_doc: Host caption pools (RICKY MARQUEE), read by runtime/src/ui/broadcast.ts. One line is picked per trigger (never the same line twice in a row per pool). Placeholders: {attacker} {victim} {winner} {loser} {name} {n}. priority: a higher value may interrupt a lower one on screen; minGapMs: the least time between two captions (KO / match lines ignore it). CONTRACT section 8.

round_start: Cameras are hot, folks. Somebody hit somebody!
Round {n}! Keep your hands inside the ring and your teeth inside your face!
We're live in five, four... oh, forget it. FIGHT!
The network paid for this set. Try to break all of it.
Round {n}! Nobody leaves until the ratings say so.

round_end: Round to {winner}! {loser}, the fans want a rematch. So do our advertisers.

match_end: And your winner, by popular demand and blunt force: {winner}!
